info.name: Metride — Driver Online Rewards
info.description:
Daily reward for drivers who stay online through a set time window (e.g. 07:00–09:00 Lagos) without missing a ride.

**Flow**
1. An admin configures and enables the reward with **Update Settings**.
2. Drivers go online with **Go Online** before the window starts and accept every ride assigned to them within the acceptance timeout.
3. After the window (plus the timeout) ends, a background job credits qualifying drivers' wallets. The credit appears as a `driver_wallet_transactions` entry with the remark `Online reward — YYYY-MM-DD 07:00–09:00`.
4. Drivers see their progress and history in **My Online Rewards**. Admins see payouts in **List Paid Rewards**.

All money values are in **kobo**. Response envelope: `{ status_code, status, message, results }`. Validation errors return 422 with `results` as `[{ message, rule, field }]`.

request.description:
Global settings for the **daily online reward**.

A driver earns `rewardAmount` (kobo) in their wallet once per day when **both** are true:
1. They are online (ride acceptance enabled) for the whole window `windowStartTime`–`windowEndTime` (Africa/Lagos time), allowing up to `graceMinutes` offline.
2. Every ride assigned to them inside the window is **accepted within `acceptanceTimeoutMinutes`**. A reject, no response, or a late accept disqualifies them for that day. A ride an admin cancels or reassigns before the timeout runs out does not count against them.

Rewards are paid automatically by a background job (every 15 min), once the window **plus** the acceptance timeout has passed. A driver can never be paid twice for the same day.

Role: `admin` only.

request.description:
Replace the reward settings. **All fields are required.**

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| isEnabled | boolean | |
| windowStartTime | string | `HH:mm`, 24-hour, Lagos time |
| windowEndTime | string | `HH:mm`; must be later than start (no midnight crossing) |
| rewardAmount | integer | kobo, ≥ 0; must be > 0 to enable |
| graceMinutes | integer | 0–60 |
| acceptanceTimeoutMinutes | integer | 1–60 |

Example: `rewardAmount: 50000` = ₦500.

Changes apply to the next payout run. The window used is stored on each reward record. Role: `admin` only.

request.description:
Paginated list of rewards paid to drivers, newest first.

| Query param | Notes |
|---|---|
| page | default 1 |
| limit | default 10, max 100 |
| date | `YYYY-MM-DD`, the reward day |
| driverIdentifier | filter to one driver |

`amount` is in kobo. Roles: `admin`, `operations`.

401 — Missing or invalid token

request.description:
The logged-in driver's online reward status for **today** plus their reward history.

`results.today` is `null` when the reward is switched off (`isRewardEnabled: false`).

`today.status` values:
| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `upcoming` | Today's window hasn't started yet |
| `in-progress` | Window is running and the driver can still qualify |
| `not-eligible` | Missed a ride, or can no longer reach `requiredOnlineMinutes` today |
| `pending-payout` | Qualified; the reward will be credited shortly |
| `rewarded` | Paid for today |

`onlineMinutes` counts only time inside the window. `amount` and `rewardAmount` are in kobo.
